name: compartment_oracle_reference_closeout
_label: Oracle-perception reference arm for attribution of the frozen vision result in results/compartment_vision_closeout (11/20 openable at seeds 5200-5209 per kind). Identical to experiments/configs/compartment_vision_closeout.json except perception: oracle (the setting of experiments/configs/compartment.json, i.e. no perception key). It never replaces the vision result: the gates below are reported for completeness, but the closeout claim for camera-based discovery is the vision run's. Seeds 5200-5209 were already scored by the vision arm, so this arm is a same-seed comparison, not a fresh held-out evaluation, and nothing is tuned after seeing it. The comparison is observational: the arms differ in perception only, but any per-seed difference is not by itself proof of cause.

gates._note: Same names and values as compartment_vision_closeout.json. Reported, never used to replace the vision result.
